title: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys
contentSnippet: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates. Here’s how we quickly patched Cloudflare, what evidence we can see of attempted exploitation, and how much of the rest of the Internet remains exposed.

title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
contentSnippet: Public traffic to private origins, with WAF, bot management, caching, and Workers, is now available to every customer with Cloudflare One connectivity.

title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
contentSnippet: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
contentSnippet: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.
